scheme_name: One-time 50% amnesty on pending motor vehicle fines
note: Kerala's one-time amnesty was a 50% concession with a payment deadline of 30 April 2026. It covered violations registered up to 31 December 2024 (cases already before the courts were excluded) and targeted a backlog of 1,02,53,151 pending violations worth ₹932.64 crore. The Transport Department order behind it is not available online, so the record carries press sources only. No new window has been announced since it closed.
